$comment: M02h6 street furniture and parked dressing (02-world.md section 5.4, C08 1.1 rule 12, DL-740, DL-741). `types` is the u8 table of RenderChunk.furniture records (index = type; append-only). `place` holds the placement rules of packages/shared/src/world/furniture.ts; every number is a design value. `bakeFill` false keeps the S13 FURNITURE section empty and the mesher places the records at mesh time (DL-740); a later re-bake that turns it on also adds this file to the bake's config hashes. `signal` and `wires` are the graph-bound items the mesher adds (one signal assembly per approach of a Signal junction, trolley wires over BusLane and TramEmbedded lanes). `pools` are the global instanced pools per look profile with their instance caps (farthest units dropped first); `parked` is the render-only dressing of parked slots the sim never fills on the tier (C01 prefix rule): drawn between ghostM and dressFarM from the player and the camera with fadeM dithered fades, thinned to dressShare, skipped within skipCarLengths car lengths of a live pose.
